title: Gentle Shell Desktop: layout directions
brief: Gentle Shell Desktop: a modern native replica of the Gentle Shell TUI on the Herdr app window (about 1600x1000). Each artboard is one full window: projects/sessions (Herdr spaces) and agents; the session chat (markdown, collapsed thinking, expandable tool cards, a diff card, a subagent card, a pending ask_user_choice question with clickable numbered options) with the Chat | Terminal switch; every TUI fact from odd/tasks/herdr-desktop-parity.md as a native panel (project, branch, dirty, model/effort/profile, persona, context, cost, plan usage 5h/7d, permission mode incl. YOLO and super-yolo, Changes, Todo, Agents, Jobs, Review/RDD, Stats, Integrations, ODD phase, TPS, jobs). Calm Gentle Shell identity: Gentleman-Cute theme surfaces, design/system.md tokens, neon rose accent, mustache mark only as brand; progressive disclosure. Buildable with Herdr mods only (flex boxes, text, SVG icons, PNGs, native markdown; no blur or web-only effects); each artboard has a 'Show Herdr blocks' toggle and a build map naming the layout node and mod of every region, plus a parity list. Session data is demonstration data.

artboards.title: A · Inspector
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to Herdr's own layout (spaces, agents, session tabs, right panel): every section one click away in a tabbed inspector; costs 372 px of chat width and shows one section at a time

artboards.title: B · Rail
artboards.tradeoff: The TUI sidebar made native: sessions and all live sections in one left rail with one-line summaries, slim header, widest chat; the rail gets long and scrolls, and session state sits next to navigation

artboards.title: C · Chat-first
artboards.tradeoff: Calmest and most reading space: drawers on demand, session controls in the composer, ⌘K for every command; less glanceable, state needs a click or a shortcut
